sql_text: SELECT catalog_sales.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk, store.s_division_id, store.s_street_type, inventory.inv_item_sk, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, store_sales.ss_addr_sk, store_sales.ss_list_price, date_dim.d_date, date_dim.d_week_seq FROM store_sales INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT date_dim.d_date IS NULL LIMIT 650

SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk, store_sales.ss_store_sk, catalog_sales.cs_item_sk, catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, store.s_zip, store.s_street_type, date_dim.d_day_name, date_dim.d_fy_quarter_seq FROM store_sales INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT store.s_number_employees IS NULL LIMIT 437

SELECT date_dim.d_date, date_dim.d_date_sk, item.i_container, item.i_color, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, inventory.inv_item_sk FROM inventory INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT inventory.inv_warehouse_sk IS NULL LIMIT 380

SELECT web_sales.ws_net_paid_inc_ship, web_sales.ws_ext_tax, store.s_manager, store.s_rec_end_date, store_sales.ss_ext_wholesale_cost, store_sales.ss_item_sk, customer.c_birth_year, customer.c_salutation, item.i_brand_id, item.i_manufact FROM web_sales INNER JOIN item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk INNER JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT customer.c_customer_id IS NULL LIMIT 587

SELECT web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk, web_sales.ws_bill_addr_sk, catalog_sales.cs_order_number, catalog_sales.cs_ship_customer_sk, store.s_market_desc, store.s_store_id, store_sales.ss_item_sk, store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk, item.i_units, item.i_item_desc FROM store_sales INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT item.i_container IS NULL LIMIT 276

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk, catalog_sales.cs_ext_tax, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, inventory.inv_date_sk, store_sales.ss_ext_wholesale_cost, store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk, date_dim.d_following_holiday, date_dim.d_dow, item.i_item_sk, item.i_rec_start_date FROM inventory INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT store_sales.ss_ext_discount_amt IS NULL LIMIT 452

SELECT web_sales.ws_ship_addr_sk, web_sales.ws_ext_sales_price, catalog_sales.cs_sales_price, catalog_sales.cs_ext_sales_price, inventory.inv_date_sk, inventory.inv_item_sk, date_dim.d_fy_quarter_seq, date_dim.d_same_day_ly, item.i_brand, item.i_container FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT catalog_sales.cs_sold_time_sk IS NULL LIMIT 379

SELECT a.ca_state AS state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_address AS a, customer AS c, store_sales AS s, date_dim AS d, item AS i WHERE a.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk AND c.c_customer_sk = s.ss_customer_sk AND s.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND s.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk AND d.d_month_seq = (SELECT DISTINCT (d_month_seq) FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 25511.63 AND d_moy = 10.0) AND i.i_current_price > 13.38 * (SELECT AVG(j.i_current_price) FROM item AS j WHERE j.i_category = i.i_category) GROUP BY a.ca_state HAVING COUNT(*) >= 89.26 ORDER BY cnt NULLS FIRST, a.ca_state NULLS FIRST LIMIT 99

SELECT web_sales.ws_sold_time_sk, web_sales.ws_ext_wholesale_cost, catalog_sales.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, catalog_sales.cs_ext_discount_amt, inventory.inv_date_sk, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, date_dim.d_week_seq, date_dim.d_date_id, item.i_manager_id, item.i_brand FROM web_sales INNER JOIN item ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT date_dim.d_qoy IS NULL LIMIT 126

SELECT web_sales.ws_ext_tax, web_sales.ws_order_number, store.s_county, store.s_market_id, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, store_sales.ss_net_paid_inc_tax, store_sales.ss_wholesale_cost, item.i_formulation, item.i_units FROM inventory INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT item.i_manager_id IS NULL LIMIT 913

SELECT inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, inventory.inv_item_sk, store_sales.ss_net_paid, store_sales.ss_ext_sales_price, customer.c_email_address, customer.c_preferred_cust_flag, date_dim.d_dow, date_dim.d_qoy, item.i_manufact_id, item.i_category_id FROM store_sales INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT customer.c_first_name IS NULL LIMIT 476

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, catalog_sales.cs_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, customer.c_first_name, customer.c_current_cdemo_sk, item.i_manufact, item.i_current_price, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, inventory.inv_date_sk FROM inventory INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT customer.c_first_shipto_date_sk IS NULL LIMIT 633

SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, CAST(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) * 100.0000 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(ws_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class), 0) AS revenueratio FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Sports', 'Books', 'Home') AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('1999-02-22' AS DATE) AND CAST('1999-03-24' AS DATE) GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100

SELECT web_sales.ws_ship_cdemo_sk, web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk, inventory.inv_item_sk, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, customer.c_birth_year, customer.c_email_address, date_dim.d_same_day_lq, date_dim.d_quarter_seq, item.i_product_name, item.i_manager_id FROM inventory INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT web_sales.ws_ship_mode_sk IS NULL LIMIT 886

SELECT web_sales.ws_net_paid_inc_ship_tax, web_sales.ws_ship_mode_sk, item.i_wholesale_cost, item.i_manufact_id, inventory.inv_date_sk, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT web_sales.ws_ship_date_sk IS NULL LIMIT 204

SELECT web_sales.ws_quantity, web_sales.ws_ship_hdemo_sk, catalog_sales.cs_ship_date_sk, catalog_sales.cs_ext_ship_cost, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, inventory.inv_item_sk, date_dim.d_current_quarter, date_dim.d_moy, item.i_class_id, item.i_units FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT item.i_item_id IS NULL LIMIT 417

SELECT web_sales.ws_warehouse_sk, web_sales.ws_net_paid_inc_ship, catalog_sales.cs_ext_tax, catalog_sales.cs_ext_ship_cost, customer.c_login, customer.c_birth_country, date_dim.d_current_week, date_dim.d_dow, item.i_rec_start_date, item.i_product_name FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN item ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT catalog_sales.cs_item_sk IS NULL LIMIT 741

SELECT web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, web_sales.ws_promo_sk, catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk, catalog_sales.cs_order_number, date_dim.d_date_sk, date_dim.d_fy_week_seq FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT catalog_sales.cs_ext_tax IS NULL LIMIT 696

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (25261.84, 17561.14 + 9.29, 24568.69 + 24.25, 23281.65 + 25.99) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 46.4), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (25786.19, 15408.31 + 12.08, 24852.41 + 14.01, 18187.1 + 27.13) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(646.24 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(1134.78, 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 18762.79 AND d_moy = 25.88 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 18038.99 AND d_moy = 25.98 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS FIRST, c_first_name NULLS FIRST, sales NULLS FIRST LIMIT 102

SELECT s_store_name, s_store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN ss_sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM date_dim, store_sales, store WHERE d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND s_gmt_offset = -5 AND d_year = 2000 GROUP BY s_store_name, s_store_id ORDER BY s_store_name, s_store_id, sun_sales, mon_sales, tue_sales, wed_sales, thu_sales, fri_sales, sat_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT store_sales.ss_net_paid_inc_tax, store_sales.ss_addr_sk, customer.c_first_shipto_date_sk, customer.c_current_cdemo_sk, web_sales.ws_net_paid, web_sales.ws_web_site_sk FROM web_sales INNER JOIN customer ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk INNER JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT web_sales.ws_bill_cdemo_sk IS NULL LIMIT 273

SELECT web_sales.ws_ext_tax, web_sales.ws_ext_wholesale_cost, catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, catalog_sales.cs_net_paid_inc_tax, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, inventory.inv_quantity_on_hand, date_dim.d_same_day_lq, date_dim.d_dow, item.i_class, item.i_formulation FROM inventory INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT web_sales.ws_ship_date_sk IS NULL LIMIT 587

WITH ss AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM store_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 5 AND ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), cs AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM catalog_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 5 AND cs_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_manufact_id), ws AS (SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS total_sales FROM web_sales, date_dim, customer_address, item WHERE i_manufact_id IN (SELECT i_manufact_id FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics')) AND ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 5 AND ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_gmt_offset = -5 GROUP BY i_manufact_id) SELECT i_manufact_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT * FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT * FROM cs UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ws) AS tmp1 GROUP BY i_manufact_id ORDER BY total_sales LIMIT 100

SELECT channel, item, return_ratio, return_rank, currency_rank FROM (SELECT 'web' AS channel, web.item, web.return_ratio, web.return_rank, web.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT ws.ws_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(176.9, 45.19)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(169.27, 43.54)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(118.98, 37.4)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(ws.ws_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(118.72, 45.02)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM web_sales AS ws LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns AS wr ON (ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE wr.wr_return_amt > 106034.39 AND ws.ws_net_profit > 10.25 AND ws.ws_net_paid > 0.0 AND ws.ws_quantity > 0.0 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 18318.73 AND d_moy = 105.86 GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk) AS in_web) AS web WHERE (web.return_rank <= 101.49 OR web.currency_rank <= 99.42) UNION SELECT 'catalog' AS channel, catalog.item, catalog.return_ratio, catalog.return_rank, catalog.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT cs.cs_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(143.4, 45.92)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(171.14, 47.97)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(141.63, 28.22)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(cs.cs_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(174.57, 32.47)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM catalog_sales AS cs LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns AS cr ON (cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE cr.cr_return_amount > 101606.37 AND cs.cs_net_profit > 12.69 AND cs.cs_net_paid > 0.0 AND cs.cs_quantity > 0.0 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 17522.37 AND d_moy = 92.36 GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk) AS in_cat) AS CATALOG WHERE (catalog.return_rank <= 80.8 OR catalog.currency_rank <= 93.01) UNION SELECT 'store' AS channel, store.item, store.return_ratio, store.return_rank, store.currency_rank FROM (SELECT item, return_ratio, currency_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY return_ratio) AS return_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_ratio) AS currency_rank FROM (SELECT sts.ss_item_sk AS item, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(142.56, 28.54)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_quantity, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(112.74, 41.23)), 0)) AS return_ratio, (CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(105.11, 28.72)) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM(COALESCE(sts.ss_net_paid, 0.0)) AS DECIMAL(148.05, 50.49)), 0)) AS currency_ratio FROM store_sales AS sts LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns AS sr ON (sts.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND sts.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk), date_dim WHERE sr.sr_return_amt > 83497.2 AND sts.ss_net_profit > 11.61 AND sts.ss_net_paid > 0.0 AND sts.ss_quantity > 0.0 AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 16999.68 AND d_moy = 126.57 GROUP BY sts.ss_item_sk) AS in_store) AS store WHERE (store.return_rank <= 127.55 OR store.currency_rank <= 76.59)) AS sq1 ORDER BY 12.77 NULLS FIRST, 30.77 NULLS FIRST, 41.4 NULLS FIRST, 25.26 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_catalog_page_sk, catalog_sales.cs_net_paid_inc_ship, customer.c_first_sales_date_sk, customer.c_birth_day, date_dim.d_weekend, date_dim.d_following_holiday FROM catalog_sales INNER JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN customer ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT customer.c_customer_sk IS NULL LIMIT 724

SELECT inventory.inv_date_sk, inventory.inv_warehouse_sk, store_sales.ss_ext_wholesale_cost, store_sales.ss_list_price, customer.c_customer_sk, customer.c_birth_month, date_dim.d_quarter_name, date_dim.d_year, item.i_category, item.i_rec_end_date FROM store_sales INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN inventory ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT inventory.inv_item_sk IS NULL LIMIT 767

SELECT web_sales.ws_bill_cdemo_sk, web_sales.ws_ext_wholesale_cost, catalog_sales.cs_ext_wholesale_cost, catalog_sales.cs_list_price, store_sales.ss_ext_discount_amt, store_sales.ss_addr_sk, date_dim.d_fy_quarter_seq, date_dim.d_quarter_seq, item.i_item_desc, item.i_manufact FROM store_sales INNER JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_item_sk = item.i_item_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT catalog_sales.cs_ship_addr_sk IS NULL LIMIT 443

SELECT SUM(ss_quantity) FROM store_sales, store, customer_demographics, customer_address, date_dim WHERE s_store_sk = ss_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 22297.89 AND ((cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = '4 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 1127.06 AND 1356.6) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 510.5 AND 1206.42) OR (cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk AND cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 1785.9 AND 1963.5)) AND ((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('CO', 'OH', 'TX') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 0.0 AND 17245.13) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('OR', 'MN', 'KY') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 1071.27 AND 25342.14) OR (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk AND ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('VA', 'CA', 'MS') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 641.58 AND 255573.58))

SELECT catalog_sales.cs_promo_sk, catalog_sales.cs_net_paid, date_dim.d_fy_year, date_dim.d_quarter_name, item.i_class, item.i_size, inventory.inv_item_sk, inventory.inv_date_sk FROM inventory INNER JOIN date_dim ON inventory.inv_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk INNER JOIN item ON inventory.inv_item_sk = item.i_item_sk INNER JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT inventory.inv_date_sk IS NULL LIMIT 201

AS d1 WHERE ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year BETWEEN 20223.63 AND 15834.42 + 16.88 INTERSECT SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id FROM catalog_sales, item AS ics, date_dim AS d2 WHERE cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year BETWEEN 23709.35 AND 14680.68 + 20.83 INTERSECT SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id FROM web_sales, item AS iws, date_dim AS d3 WHERE ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND d3.d_year BETWEEN 15485.99 AND 14130.96 + 14.94) AS sq1 WHERE i_brand_id = brand_id AND i_class_id = class_id AND i_category_id = category_id), avg_sales AS (SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year BETWEEN 19141.56 AND 23564.99 + 19.86 UNION ALL SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS item, date_dim WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 20772.15 + 18.21 AND d_moy = 126.4 GROUP BY i_brand_id, * cs_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items) AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year = 17735.59 + 18.31 AND d_moy = 116.44 GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id HAVING SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales) UNION ALL SELECT 'web' AS channel, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales, COUNT(*) AS number_sales FROM web_sales, item, date_dim WHERE ws_item_sk IN (SELECT WITH year_total AS (SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type FROM customer, store_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2001, 2001 + 1) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id, c_first_name AS customer_first_name, c_last_name AS customer_last_name, d_year AS year_, SUM(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type FROM customer, web_sales, date_dim WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2001, 2001 + 1) GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name FROM year_total AS t_s_firstyear, year_total AS t_s_secyear, year_total AS t_w_firstyear, year_total AS t_w_secyear WHERE t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_firstyear.year_ = 2001 AND t_s_secyear.year_ = 2001 + 1 AND t_w_firstyear.year_ = 2001 AND t_w_secyear.year_ = 2001 + 1 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN CAST(t_w_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_w_firstyear.year_total, 0) ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN CAST(t_s_secyear.year_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(t_s_firstyear.year_total, 0) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

COALESCE(profit_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM ss UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, cs_call_center_sk AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM cs, cr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, ws.wp_web_page_sk AS id, sales, COALESCE(returns_, 0.0) AS returns_, (profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM ws LEFT JOIN wr ON ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST, id NULLS FIRST, returns_ DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 101

WITH ws AS (SELECT d_year AS ws_sold_year, ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk AS ws_customer_sk, SUM(ws_quantity) AS ws_qty, SUM(ws_wholesale_cost) AS ws_wc, SUM(ws_sales_price) AS ws_sp FROM web_sales LEFT JOIN web_returns ON wr_order_number = ws_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE wr_order_number IS NULL GROUP BY d_year, ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk), cs AS (SELECT d_year AS cs_sold_year, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk AS cs_customer_sk, SUM(cs_quantity) AS cs_qty, SUM(cs_wholesale_cost) AS cs_wc, SUM(cs_sales_price) AS cs_sp FROM catalog_sales LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON cr_order_number = cs_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE cr_order_number IS NULL GROUP BY d_year, cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk), ss AS (SELECT d_year AS ss_sold_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity) AS ss_qty, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS ss_wc, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS ss_sp FROM store_sales LEFT JOIN store_returns ON sr_ticket_number = ss_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE sr_ticket_number IS NULL GROUP BY d_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk) SELECT ss_sold_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ROUND(CAST((ss_qty * 1.00) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0)), 0), 2) AS ratio, ss_qty AS store_qty, ss_wc AS store_wholesale_cost, ss_sp AS store_sales_price, COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) + COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) AS other_chan_qty, COALESCE(ws_wc, 0) + COALESCE(cs_wc, 0) AS other_chan_wholesale_cost, COALESCE(ws_sp, 0) + COALESCE(cs_sp, 0) AS other_chan_sales_price FROM ss LEFT JOIN ws ON (ws_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND ws_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk) LEFT JOIN cs ON (cs_sold_year = ss_sold_year AND cs_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND cs_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk) WHERE (COALESCE(ws_qty, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(cs_qty, 0) > 0) AND ss_sold_year = 2000 ORDER BY ss_sold_year, ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_qty DESC NULLS LAST, ss_wc DESC NULLS LAST, ss_sp DESC NULLS LAST, other_chan_qty, other_chan_wholesale_cost, other_chan_sales_price, ratio LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(51.96, 25.76)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(79.41, 19.57)) AS net_loss FROM store_sales UNION ALL SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(50.06, 24.24)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(83.82, 22.68)) AS profit, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, store WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(89.54, 15.48)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(87.55, 22.94)) AS net_loss FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(77.03, 14.69)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(66.76, 22.46)) AS profit, cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, catalog_page WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(65.05, 14.91)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(51.51, 19.55)) AS net_loss FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(83.57, 15.34)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(70.06, 14.35)) AS profit, wr_return_amt AS return_amt, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)) AS salesreturns, date_dim, web_site WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', s_store_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', cp_catalog_page_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', web_site_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST, id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 102

s_store_id), csr AS (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(80.44, 17.45)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(60.91, 17.8)) AS net_loss FROM CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(78.39, 19.5)) WITH sr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty FROM store_returns, item, date_dim WHERE sr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), cr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns, item, date_dim WHERE cr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), wr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty FROM web_returns, item, date_dim WHERE wr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((sr_item_qty * 7.38) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(24.39, 0) * 820.42 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((cr_item_qty * 8.7) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(28.65, 0) * 904.62 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((wr_item_qty * 12.84) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(32.7, 0) * 719.49 AS wr_dev, CAST((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(25.11, 0) AS average FROM sr_items, cr_items, wr_items WHERE sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id AND sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id NULLS FIRST, sr_item_qty NULLS FIRST LIMIT 101

WITH ssr AS (SELECT s_store_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ss_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(66.2, 23.0)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(87.1, 21.35)) AS net_loss FROM store_sales UNION ALL SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk, sr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(58.07, 19.26)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(55.3, 24.59)) AS profit, sr_return_amt AS return_amt, sr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM store_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, store WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY cs_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, cs_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(74.47, 17.36)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(51.14, 23.94)) AS net_loss FROM catalog_sales UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk, cr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(79.1, 25.99)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(49.5, 19.75)) AS profit, cr_return_amount AS return_amt, cr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM catalog_returns) AS salesreturns, date_dim, catalog_page WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id), wsr AS (SELECT web_site_id, SUM(sales_price) AS sales, SUM(profit) AS profit, SUM(return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, ws_sold_date_sk AS date_sk, ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price, ws_net_profit AS profit, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(52.84, 21.74)) AS return_amt, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(56.97, 16.18)) AS net_loss FROM web_sales UNION ALL SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk, wr_returned_date_sk AS date_sk, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(66.42, 20.97)) AS sales_price, CAST(0.0 AS DECIMAL(76.59, 15.67)) AS profit, wr_return_amt AS return_amt, wr_net_loss AS net_loss FROM web_returns LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)) AS salesreturns, date_dim, web_site WHERE date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-06' AS DATE) AND wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk GROUP BY web_site_id) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, CONCAT('store', s_store_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM ssr UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, CONCAT('catalog_page', cp_catalog_page_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM csr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, CONCAT('web_site', web_site_id) AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM wsr) AS x GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id) ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST, id NULLS FIRST LIMIT 99

WITH ss AS (SELECT s_store_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit FROM store_sales, date_dim WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_sk), sr AS (SELECT s_store_sk, SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM store_returns, store WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND sr_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_sk), cs AS (SELECT cs_call_center_sk, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(cs_net_profit) AS profit FROM catalog_sales WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) GROUP BY cs_call_center_sk), cr AS (SELECT cr_call_center_sk, SUM(cr_return_amount) AS returns_, SUM(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM catalog_returns, date_dim WHERE cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) GROUP BY cr_call_center_sk), ws AS (SELECT wp_web_page_sk, SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, SUM(ws_net_profit) AS profit FROM web_sales, date_dim WHERE ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp_web_page_sk), wr AS (SELECT wp_web_page_sk, SUM(wr_return_amt) AS returns_, SUM(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss FROM web_returns, date_dim WHERE wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-23' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-22' AS DATE) AND wr_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk GROUP BY wp_web_page_sk) SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns_) AS returns_, SUM(profit) AS profit FROM (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, ss.s_store_sk AS id, sales, COALESCE(returns_, 0.0) AS returns_, (profit - COALESCE(profit_loss, 0.0)) AS profit FROM ss LEFT JOIN sr ON ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, cs_call_center_sk AS id, sales, returns_, (profit - profit_loss) AS profit FROM cs, cr UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, ws.wp_web_page_sk AS id, sales, COALESCE(returns_, 0.0) AS returns_, (profit - WITH frequent_ss_items AS (SELECT itemdesc, i_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date AS solddate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM store_sales, date_dim, (SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc FROM 1 FOR 30) AS itemdesc, * FROM item) AS sq1 WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2, 2000 + 3) GROUP BY itemdesc, i_item_sk, d_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 4), max_store_sales AS (SELECT MAX(csales) AS tpcds_cmax FROM (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS csales FROM store_sales, customer, date_dim WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2, 2000 + 3) GROUP BY c_customer_sk) AS sq2), best_ss_customer AS (SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS ssales FROM store_sales, customer, max_store_sales WHERE ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_customer_sk HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) > (CAST(50 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(100.0, 0)) * MAX(tpcds_cmax)) SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, sales FROM (SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales FROM catalog_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 2 AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND cs_item_sk = item_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name UNION ALL SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales FROM web_sales, customer, date_dim, frequent_ss_items, best_ss_customer WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 2 AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND ws_item_sk = item_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk AND ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name) AS sq3 ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS FIRST, c_first_name NULLS FIRST, sales NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

WITH sr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty FROM store_returns, item, date_dim WHERE sr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), cr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty FROM catalog_returns, item, date_dim WHERE cr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id), wr_items AS (SELECT i_item_id AS item_id, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty FROM web_returns, item, date_dim WHERE wr_item_sk = i_item_sk AND d_date IN (SELECT d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date IN ('2000-06-30', '2000-09-27', '2000-11-17'))) AND wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk GROUP BY i_item_id) SELECT sr_items.item_id, sr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((sr_item_qty * 10.58) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(25.13, 0) * 744.45 AS sr_dev, cr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((cr_item_qty * 9.07) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(22.96, 0) * 1174.24 AS cr_dev, wr_item_qty, CAST(CAST((wr_item_qty * 9.88) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty), 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(23.7, 0) * 755.17 AS wr_dev, CAST((sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(25.31, 0) AS average FROM sr_items, cr_items, wr_items WHERE sr_items.item_id = cr_items.item_id AND sr_items.item_id = wr_items.item_id ORDER BY sr_items.item_id NULLS FIRST, sr_item_qty NULLS FIRST LIMIT 99

SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip, SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 328.93) THEN 9.79 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "30 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 212.81) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 577.21) THEN 9.57 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "31-60 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 668.54) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 1160.2) THEN 10.63 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "61-90 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 1156.46) AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 840.33) THEN 10.85 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "91-120 days", SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 1519.22) THEN 11.97 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ">120 days" FROM store_sales, store_returns, store, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2 WHERE d2.d_year = 17404.16 AND d2.d_moy = 103.65 AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip LIMIT 100

cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number GROUP BY cs_item_sk HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 15.41 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)), cross_sales AS (SELECT b_city, ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip, ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name, ad2.ca_city AS c_city, ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip, d1.d_year AS syear, d2.d_year AS fsyear, d3.d_year AS s2year, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1, SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2, SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3 FROM store_sales, store_returns, cs_ui, date_dim AS d1, date_dim AS d2, date_dim AS d3, store, customer, customer_demographics AS cd1, customer_demographics AS cd2, promotion, household_demographics AS hd1, household_demographics AS hd2, customer_address AS ad1, customer_address AS ad2, income_band AS ib1, income_band AS ib2, item WHERE ss_store_sk = s_store_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk AND ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk AND ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk AND c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk AND c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk AND ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk AND hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk AND hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status AND i_color IN ('purple', 'burlywood', 'indian', 'spring', 'floral', 'medium') AND i_current_price BETWEEN 461.27 AND 616.42 + 89.98 AND i_current_price BETWEEN 801.19 + 10.66 AND 806.21 + 133.91 GROUP BY i_product_name, i_item_sk, s_store_name, s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year) SELECT cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs1.store_zip, cs1.b_street_number, cs1.b_street_name, cs1.b_city, cs1.b_zip, cs1.c_street_number, cs1.c_street_name, cs1.c_city, cs1.c_zip, cs1.syear AS cs1syear, cs1.cnt AS cs1cnt, cs1.s1 AS s11, cs1.s2 AS s21, cs1.s3 AS s31, cs2.s1 AS s12, cs2.s2 AS s22, cs2.s3 AS s32, cs2.syear, cs2.cnt FROM cross_sales AS cs1, cross_sales AS cs2 WHERE cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk AND cs1.syear = 24650.44 AND cs2.syear = 15815.47 + 12.27 AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1
